_comment: The Mantra RULEBOOK, encoded. This file is CONFIGURATION, not a measurement: which elevens the game
lets you field is written down by fantacalcio.it, so it is read, never fitted and never inferred from
observed line-ups. Do not confuse it with `features.simultaneous_caps`, which MEASURES how many men of
a role real coaches field together (p90 off real starting elevens) and is used for roster DEPTH: that
is football, this is the game's law. A per-role cap also cannot express this constraint, because the
constraint is JOINT - a module is a set of typed places, and many places accept a CHOICE of roles.
Source: the public rulebook page (no paywall, unlike the listone and the votes), plus the official
board of the eleven schemes, 2026/2027 edition, and the substitution table. Retrieved 05/08/2026.
https://www.fantacalcio.it/regolamenti/sistema-mantra
https://content.fantacalcio.it/web/img/medium/e382c267-1773-4ef9-ba24-a99d0bc2fbce.jpg  (schemes)
https://content.fantacalcio.it/web/img/medium/53b9bee6-224f-4d53-ada2-47be4c6205c9.jpg  (substitutions)
https://content.fantacalcio.it/web/risorse/Tabella-sostituzioni-per-schema-2024-2025.pdf
TRANSCRIPTION CHECK, and it passed on all eleven: the rulebook states that every scheme fields 5
defensive-stamp places (Dd, Ds, Dc, B, E, M) and 5 offensive-stamp ones (C, T, W, A, Pc). Counted over
the `lines` below, every module returns exactly 5 and 5, with the hybrid places always on the offensive
side. The line counts also reproduce each module's own NAME. Two independent checks, so the table was
not mis-read.
Consequences that need no model at all, only this file (see docs/model/assistente-asta-v1.md §13):
a `Pc` fits at most TWO places in any scheme and only ONE in six of the eleven, while an `A` fits up to
three - so at equal fantamedia an `A` is worth more than a `Pc`, by the rules. `Dc` is the only
defender with a place in every scheme (2 or 3); `B` has exactly one and only where the defence is a
three, `Dd`/`Ds` exactly one and only where it is a four - so the defence is where a roster COMMITS to
a family of schemes, and owning both wastes one of them.
_stamp_comment: The rulebook's own split, quoted: 5 defensive-stamp men and 5 offensive-stamp men per eleven.
_slot_roles_comment: A PLACE is typed, and a hybrid place accepts a choice of roles - this is the whole of the constraint.
Note what is absent: there is no pure `A` place and no pure `Pc` place anywhere in the game. Every
striker's place is `A/PC` (or `T/A/PC`), which is why a Pc and an A are interchangeable there, while a
`W/A` place takes an A and NOT a Pc.
_modules_comment: The eleven schemes, each as its four lines beyond the fixed goalkeeper: defence, midfield, trequarti,
attack ('Oltre alla posizione fissa del portiere, i calciatori vengono schierati in quattro linee di
gioco'). The goalkeeper is implicit and is the same single `P` place in every scheme.
A place drawn low on the board can still belong to the line above it: the `E/W` of a 3-5-1-1 is one of
the five midfielders, and the four places of a 4-1-4-1 are drawn at trequarti height. The line the
module's NAME counts is the one recorded here.
_lineup_bans_comment: Quoted from the rulebook: adaptations barred AT LINE-UP TIME only ('esclusivamente in fase di
inserimento formazione'), to discourage abuse. The same moves become possible during SUBSTITUTION,
with the out-of-position malus. Read `from` as the man's listed role and `to` as the place.

lineup_bans.note: a B, Dd or Ds may not be fielded in a Dc place
and the mirror: a Ds may not be fielded in a Dd place
an E may not take a pure M place; an M/C place stays open to him
an M may not take a pure E place; an E/W place stays open to him
a W may not take a pure T place; a T/A place stays open to him

_substitution_comment: The official substitution matrix. READING, and it is not symmetric: the ROW is the role of the man who
came out - which is what says WHICH place opened - and the COLUMN is the role of the substitute coming
in. Verified on two asymmetric pairs: `Pc` out / `A` in is OK unconditionally (every Pc place is A/PC,
which already accepts an A), while `A` out / `Pc` in is conditional, because an A may have been in a
W/A place and that place does not accept a Pc. Same shape for B and Dc: a DC/B place is open to a Dc
unconditionally, a pure DC place takes a B only at a malus.
Values: OK = no penalty; -1 = allowed with the out-of-position malus of one point; NO = not allowed.
The three asterisks are the rulebook's own footnotes, and they all turn on whether THAT scheme's place
lists both roles in alternativa - i.e. on `slot_roles` above:
*   OK where the scheme has the roles in alternativa. Otherwise NO.
**  OK where the scheme has the roles in alternativa. Otherwise -1.
*** OK where the scheme has the roles in alternativa. NO in the 4-1-4-1. Otherwise -1.
The substitution engine itself is ordered, and the order is what gives a bench its value: an OPTIMAL
solution keeps the chosen scheme, an EFFICIENT one changes scheme, an ADAPTED one pays the malus. So a
roster's cover is not a free choice among the bench - it is what this hierarchy can reach.
The goalkeeper is a closed role: only a Por covers a Por, and a Por covers nothing else.
_modifiers_comment: The rulebook REFUSES the classic modifiers, and says why: 'L'incompatibilita' tra il sistema Mantra e i
modificatori classici e' concettuale e non tecnica' - the schemes are already balanced, so a defence
modifier would price a balance the module already imposes. What exists instead is optional and named:
R-Factor (performance) and D-Factor (defensive unit, on the best 5 defensive men or 5+1 with the
keeper). So the only way the fantavoto depends on WHERE a man is fielded is the out-of-position malus
above - which matters for the assignment: the objective is the sum EVALUATED PER PLACE, not a plain sum
of fantamedie. Whether this league switches the two factors on is a league question, not a rule.
The two factors are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE - a league runs one or the other, never both - and they compose
with the optional Fair Play and Captain bonuses.
R-Factor, quoted: it 'premia (o penalizza) la qualita' complessiva espressa dalla fantasquadra in campo
misurando il numero di calciatori con voto di base almeno sufficiente'. Note VOTO DI BASE: bonuses do
not feed it, so it rewards a different thing from the fantamedia. Its numeric scale is NOT on the public
rules page and must be read from the league's own settings before anything is computed with it.
D-Factor counts the five defensive men, or - where a scheme fields more than five men with roles
Dc/B/Dd/Ds/E/M - the best five by grade, provided at least three are Dc, B, Dd or Ds.
